task.description:
Draft a new stage 'F8 — Tenant Management GUI' in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md. This stage extends Stage F7 (Tenant Onboarding GUI, ONB-UI-01..04 RELEASED) with a full CRUD management interface for registered tenants.

## User request (verbatim)
"A user with correspondent roles/permissions can view registered tenants in the system GUI. From this form he also can add, edit and delete (deactivate) tenant."

## Business context
- The platform is multi-tenant. Each tenant is stored in public.tenant and has an isolated PostgreSQL schema + a dedicated Keycloak realm.
- Tenant registration already works via the ONB-UI flow (F7). That flow remains. The new feature adds a management surface on top.
- 'Delete' means deactivation (soft-delete), NOT hard deletion, because removing a tenant's schema and Keycloak realm is a destructive, irreversible operation that must be handled separately with explicit confirmation.
- The role that can manage tenants is PLATFORM_ADMIN (already defined in the system).

## Requirements to draft (ID prefix: TM, stage: F8)

Draft the following requirements. Use exactly this ID prefix and numbering:

**TM-01 — Tenant list page [MUST]**
A PLATFORM_ADMIN can navigate to a 'Tenants' page in the Admin section that lists all registered tenants. The list must show: slug, display_name, idp_realm_id, status (active/inactive), created_at. The list must be paginated (same pattern as the existing Users list page). Non-PLATFORM_ADMIN users must not see the page (hidden from DOM, redirect to login).

**TM-02 — Add tenant from list page [MUST]**
From the Tenant list page, PLATFORM_ADMIN can initiate tenant registration via a button/link that opens the existing ONB-UI-02 registration form (no new form needed — reuse Stage F7). Cross-reference ONB-UI-01, ONB-UI-02.

**TM-03 — Edit tenant [MUST]**
From the Tenant list page, PLATFORM_ADMIN can navigate to an Edit Tenant form for any listed tenant. The form must allow editing: display_name, hostname, redirect_uris. The slug and idp_realm_id are immutable after creation. On save, the platform calls a PATCH /api/v1/tenants/:slug endpoint. The backend must update the tenant record and propagate redirect_uri changes to the corresponding Keycloak realm client.

**TM-04 — Deactivate tenant [MUST]**
From the Tenant list page or Edit Tenant form, PLATFORM_ADMIN can deactivate a tenant. Deactivation must: (1) set a status column on the tenant record to 'inactive'; (2) disable all users in the corresponding Keycloak realm; (3) NOT delete the PostgreSQL schema or the Keycloak realm. A confirmation dialog must be shown before deactivation ('This will prevent all SwiftRoute users from logging in. Continue?'). The default tenant (slug='default') MUST NOT be deactivatable — the UI must hide the deactivate action for it.

**TM-05 — Reactivate tenant [MUST]**
From the Tenant list page or Edit Tenant form, PLATFORM_ADMIN can reactivate a previously deactivated tenant. Reactivation must: re-enable all previously disabled users in the corresponding Keycloak realm; set status back to 'active'. A deactivated tenant's status must be visually distinct in the list (e.g. greyed out row, 'Inactive' badge).

## Backend API implications (note for REQ-ANALYST to include as cross-references)
These requirements imply new backend endpoints that do not yet exist:
- GET /api/v1/tenants — list all tenants (paginated)
- PATCH /api/v1/tenants/:slug — update display_name, hostname, redirect_uris
- POST /api/v1/tenants/:slug/deactivate — soft-delete
- POST /api/v1/tenants/:slug/reactivate — re-enable

REQ-ANALYST must note these as acceptance criteria items — they will become Type A or Type E design artefacts in a subsequent WF-02 run.

## Instructions for REQ-ANALYST
1. Read the end of docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md (after Stage F7 / ONB-UI-04)
2. Append a new '## Stage F8 — Tenant Management GUI' section after Stage F7
3. Write TM-01 through TM-05 using the same format as ONB-UI-01..04 (ID, priority tag, description, acceptance criteria in GIVEN/WHEN/THEN format, See: cross-references)
4. Add TM-01..TM-05 entries to docs/status/requirement_status.yaml with status: PENDING
5. Call fn:register-inner-report then fn:complete-handoff
6. Set next_action: 'Route to REQ-VALIDATOR'
acceptance_criteria: Stage F8 section appended to docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md after Stage F7
TM-01 through TM-05 each have: ID, [MUST] priority, description paragraph, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria, See: cross-references
TM-03 and TM-04/TM-05 note the new backend API endpoints as acceptance criteria
TM-04 includes the default tenant guard (slug='default' cannot be deactivated)
TM-01..TM-05 added to docs/status/requirement_status.yaml with status: PENDING, stage: F8
No contradictions with existing RELEASED requirements (ONB-UI-01..04, OIDC-17..19)
